intent: Four umbrella-topic concepts, not depictions of specific experiments.

images.alt: Concept illustration of robots with complementary capabilities connected around a shared goal
images.caption: Different capabilities, connected by a shared goal.

A polished isometric concept illustration, clearly illustrated rather than photographic; neither flat vector art nor thick-outlined cartoon. Warm cream background #f1eee7 with ample negative space, charcoal mechanical details, restrained deep muted purple #5d3b73 and warm ochre/burnt-orange accents. No tables, desks, elevated platforms, miniature diorama bases, dramatic interiors, photorealistic textures, neon, faces on robots, text, letters, logos, charts claiming results or watermarks. All objects rest on one continuous neutral ground plane. Concept should communicate a broad research field, not a specific published experiment. Balanced composition readable at 400px, all important elements inside generous margins. Theme: COLLABORATIVE MULTI-AGENT SYSTEMS. Show four different small robot agents around a central shared workspace: one wheeled sensing rover, one compact mobile manipulator, one low carrying robot, and one communication-equipped rover. Three subtly colored interlocking geometric pieces form a single orange-and-ivory hexagon in the center as a visual metaphor for complementary contributions. Fine purple graph links connect all four robot agents, with one orange node at the shared workspace. Robots should appear engaged toward the same center, all on the ground. Elegant uncluttered triangular/isometric composition, understated dimensional forms, conceptual teamwork and shared capabilities. No firefighting, lifting a beam, robot transfer, detailed laboratory or specific testbed.
